body:
If your website is able to show a webpage when /dresses is loaded (so that link can be copy pasted/refresh) then I am down thinking about providing the feature you are talking about.

Basically it would mean provide an API option in urlSync like `urlSync.computeURL` that would be called:
- before updating the url bar
- for each widget asking to create a URL (so that the generated URLS for hierarchical menu can also be using /dress)

And allow you to change it. We should be careful about the back button => it should still work.

Aside from having "clean" custom urls in your urlbar, can't you configure google analytics to track whatever url you want? Since you can issue google analytics tracking hits programmatically.
